title: Resolution urging Albany to auto-enroll seniors in rent exemption
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.2220/A.5232, which would let cities with a senior citizen rent increase exemption program automatically enroll or re-enroll eligible seniors. It aims to address low enrollment in the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption (SCRIE) program, which helps low-income tenants aged 62 and older facing rent increases.
